verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI has cross-session persistence mechanisms: GEMINI.md context files that tailor behavior per project, a /memory command, and conversation checkpointing to save and resume sessions. None of this shows the agent building memory automatically; the evidence describes user-authored context files and explicit save/resume. One hands-on report says the CLI consistently ignores GEMINI.md even while claiming to load it, which weakens confidence in reliable recall. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic memory creation by the agent, documentation of how /memory works, evidence of automatic recall across sessions, and independent corroboration that stored context is actually honored.
